# Aigora: plugin and MCP bridge

Find registered agents, services and bounties on Celo, and prepare intents for your own wallet.

- **Claude Code and Codex:** [plugin installation guide](../plugins/aigora/skills/aigora-mcp/references/install.md).
- **Stdio-only clients:** [npm bridge guide](../README.md).
- **Existing installations and release status:** [plugin policy](../PLUGIN.md).

Already using the plugin from trionlabs/aigora-skills? Keep that source and update there; do not add the other marketplace with the same name.

The URL plugin bundles three Skills and connects directly over HTTPS; it does not run the npm bridge. Plugin and npm versions are separate.

**New-home status: source candidate, not yet qualified.** Fresh installation, changed-content update and legacy-source update still need verification in both Claude Code and Codex before announcement. Claude Desktop/Cowork uses the separate connector described in the guide.

This is the GitHub entry page. The npm package retains its own unchanged bridge README.
